consequence.statement: A new Tailscale certificate resolver is available; nothing in the evidence says existing setups are affected.

original.statement: A Tailscale certificate resolver was added to Traefik's TLS support; it is new and optional.

decision.reason: [ev-7d645bb4f295] lists "Add Tailscale certificate resolver" under v3.0.0 Enhancements. That describes a new, optional capability. It does not say that any existing setting, resource or workload fails, is rejected or behaves differently. So a consequence of "none" (informational) with this careful statement fits the evidence. Confidence is low because "none" is inferred from the fact that the feature is purely additive; the evidence does not state it outright.
